Strings.addon.title: Mining Hotspots
Strings.addon.description: The nearest ring hotspots for a commodity (Platinum, Painite, Low Temperature Diamonds, Void Opals…) around your system or one you type, from Spansh: ring, ring type, how many hotspots overlap, reserve and distance. Plus every hotspot you've mapped yourself, from your own journals.
Strings.ui.reference_tip: Type a system to search around it (leave empty for where you are)
Strings.ui.radius_tip: How far to look (click to change)
Strings.ui.min_tip: Only rings with this many hotspots of it overlapping (click to change)
Strings.ui.auto_tip: Search again automatically after each jump (when no system is typed)
Strings.ui.copy_tip: Select the name and press Ctrl+C to paste it in the galaxy map
